item.title: Cellular Automata Playground
item.description:
Overview

Cellular Automata has always fascinated me, and as a teenager I even programmed some recreations of Conway’s Game of Life. After getting into Houdini and seeing some beautiful rules or patterns, I wanted a way to play around with rules and create my own artworks.

In particular, I was inspired by the concept of multiple rules on a singular canvas. I had seen someone implement this concept poorly, and I wanted to do it better. The inspiration took me down many deep rabbit-holes and late nights bleary eyed wondering how to fix something or implementing a new feature.
